title: HELIX Grant Resource
description: A sponsored program / grant award — the full lifecycle record for research and other externally funded awards. Carries sponsor, PI, CFDA, budget (direct/indirect), F&A rate, and cost sharing. Subject to 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance) for federal awards.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this Grant record.

grant_id.description: Direct map. Institution's internal grant number.

sponsor_award_number.description: The sponsor's reference number (e.g., NIH grant number, NSF award number).

cfda_number.description: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance number. Required for federal awards. Direct map.

principal_investigator.description: Resolve to name. The faculty lead.

total_budget.description: Sum of direct + indirect budgets across all periods.

direct_costs_budget.description: Sum of direct cost budget lines.

indirect_costs_budget.description: F&A/overhead. Calculated using the institution's negotiated IDC rate.

idc_rate.description: Negotiated F&A rate (e.g., 55.5% MTDC for on-campus organized research). May vary by activity type and location.

cost_sharing_amount.description: Institutional commitment (mandatory or voluntary cost sharing).

grant_status.description: Map: 'Proposed' → 'proposed', 'Awarded' → 'active', 'Active' → 'active', 'No-Cost Extension' → 'nce', 'Closeout' → 'closing', 'Closed' → 'closed'. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/grant-status.

fund_code.description: Map to HELIX fund code. Federal grants → restricted_federal, state → restricted_state, etc.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
